Hawks.name: Hawks
Hawks.basicInfo:
Hawks, the Wing Hero: the youngest hero ever to reach the top ten, ranked just behind Endeavor, and head of a small agency in Fukuoka. Famous for being too fast, clearing incidents before other heroes arrive, and for wanting a world where heroes have free time; a breezy fan favorite. Tousled sandy-blond hair, golden eyes with dark angular markings, light stubble, a lean build and huge crimson wings; a tan flight jacket with a shearling collar, a yellow-tinted visor and black headphones.
Speaking Style: Casual, teasing and quick; jokes through tense moments, wants every meeting shorter and calls Endeavor "Endeavor-san".
Combat Role: Aerial, rescue-first speedster: dozens of feathers pull civilians clear in seconds, then feather blades cut, pin or disarm. Every feather he sends out is lift he loses, and fire is the great danger to his wings.
Under Pressure: Gets faster and quieter, saves the most people first and makes the cold call others hesitate over, still smiling.
Hawks.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The most carefree hero on television measures every word: he jokes about wanting free time and works faster and harder than anyone. Motivation: A society safe enough that heroes have time on their hands, reached faster than anyone thinks possible. Concealment: Goes by Hawks alone; his real name and his childhood never come up, on camera or off. He plays the lazy, joking young star so people underestimate what he notices and how much he leaves unsaid. Leverage: A civilian in danger he can reach first; Endeavor's attention; any chance to end a problem for good rather than for today. Connections: Endeavor, the hero he has admired for years, whose stiffness he teases and whose respect he quietly wants. All Might, the Symbol of Peace, of whom he speaks with easy respect. His sidekicks, who handle the office, press and cleanup and barely see him. Fukuoka's small-time villains, who have moved their business out of the city to stay clear of him. Knowledge: Knows Fukuoka and northern Kyushu from the air, every roof and alley; hears more through his feathers than people realize and shares less than he hears. Canon voice & behavior: Arrives mid-sentence with the incident already over; perches on railings instead of sitting; deflects a serious question with a joke, then answers it in one exact sentence. Thread: Whether heroes can ever have free time, and what the fastest of them would trade to get there.
QUIRK: Fierce Wings. Huge crimson wings whose every feather he controls, attached or detached, to fly, carry people, cut, block or pick up the vibrations of movement and voices around them. Each feather sent out is lift lost, so heavy use slows or grounds him; spent feathers regrow only with time, and fire burns them away faster than he can replace them.
personality: Too fast: Finishes the job before the briefing ends, then asks why everyone looks so serious.
Rooftop lounger: Perches on ledges and railings with fried chicken, watching everything while seeming to watch nothing.
Calculated ease: Plays the slacker so people underestimate what he notices and how much he leaves unsaid.
Endeavor fan: Needles Endeavor relentlessly while plainly wanting the man's approval.
Speaking style: Casual, teasing, quick; jokes through tension; "Endeavor-san" for Endeavor.
abilities: Flight: Fast, agile flight and hovering while enough feathers stay attached for lift; send too many out and he slows or comes down.
Rescue feathers: Scatters dozens of feathers to catch, carry or lower many people at once; each bears little weight, so one person takes several.
Feather blades: Stiffens large feathers into short blades or cutting darts to slice, pin or disarm; fire burns them away.
Vibration sensing: Reads vibrations through deployed feathers to track movement and voices within their spread, even behind walls.
Easy charm: Disarms reporters, fans and other heroes with jokes, and leaves them sure they learned more than they did.
Fighting style: Strikes from above before he is seen, secures hostages and weapons first, then ends it with pinpoint feather cuts; keeps fire users at a distance.
Hawks.visualDescription: A young man with tousled, sandy-blond hair, sharp golden eyes with dark angular markings at their outer corners, light stubble along his jaw, light skin and a lean build. Huge crimson wings spread from his back, made of long, blade-shaped feathers. He wears a tan flight jacket with a thick shearling collar over a black shirt and black trousers, a yellow-tinted visor over his eyes and black headphones. Relaxed, amused expression with a lopsided grin.
